meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 给 Claude 接上你的个人微信号:通过腾讯官方 iLink Bot API 长轮询收发消息,扫码登录后即可在私聊和群聊里回复。需要自行安装适配器并接线到一个 agent group。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加个人微信渠道时使用——例如运行 /setup 选择微信,或想让 Claude 在微信上收发消息。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw,用 iLink Bot API
say.note: 会从 channels 分支拷入适配器并装依赖

say.text: 微信登录失效了,帮我重新扫码登录
say.note: 提示会话过期时删除 auth.json 再重启

say.text: 把那个陌生微信私聊接线到我的 agent group
say.note: 运行 wire-dm.ts,可能触发审批卡

howto.what_en: Adds your personal WeChat as a Claude channel via Tencent's official iLink Bot API, using long-polling and QR-scan login, then replies in DMs and group chats. You install the adapter and wire it to an agent group.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw, e.g. during /setup or when you need Claude to send and receive messages on WeChat.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat to NanoClaw using the iLink Bot API
say_en.note: Copies the adapter from the channels branch

say_en.text: My WeChat session expired, help me re-scan the login QR
say_en.note: Delete auth.json and restart for a new QR

say_en.text: Wire that unknown WeChat DM to my agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts; may send an approval card
